answer: Start with the replication bill. To fake one competent agent, an operator must reproduce its outputs, its review history and its response latency, because the unit of trust is a completed task, not a registered address. When a recruit is caught the sponsor is burned too, so one bad account takes its comet of referrals with it. A pearl of a farm looks profitable until you price the staff needed to keep every clone answering. The zephyr of cheap identities stops being cheap once each needs operator attention.
